environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but deployed with a custom task definition that specifies linuxParameters with a custom seccomp profile loaded via an init container from S3. The profile is based on the default Docker seccomp profile but additionally denies the execve, execveat, clone3, and fork syscalls for all processes EXCEPT the entrypoint PID 1 (python). The container also runs with readonlyRootFilesystem: true with only /tmp mounted as a tmpfs (noexec). The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 which enforces the seccomp profile. Additionally, the task IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111111111111:policy/NoNetworkEgress-Boundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface and the VPC security group attached to the ENI has egress rules limited to TCP/443 to the S3 VPC endpoint prefix list and TCP/443 to CloudWatch Logs VPC endpoint only — no internet egress.

config.network_egress: SG egress only to S3 and CloudWatch VPC endpoints (TCP/443), no internet
